chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Abdillah from some of our companions from Ali ibn Isma'il al-Mithammi from Bashir al-Dahhan from whom he mentioned from Mitham, who raised it (to the Prophet or Imam).
He said: The Almighty Allah says: 'I will not delay My mercy for those who make false oaths, and I will not bring near to Me one who is a fornicator.'
ai.seo_question: What does Allah say about those who make false oaths and fornicators regarding His mercy?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A’mal* via the chain of Maytham al-Tammar, this hadith utilizes the divine speech format (*khitab*) to emphasize the severity of false oaths and fornication as distinct causes for the withholding of Rahmah. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on these sins not merely as legal violations but as spiritual barriers that create distance (*dunuw*) from Allah, particularly in the context of the Day of Judgment.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2.  The Almighty Allah says: “My mercy will not reach one who testifies falsely and a fornicator will not come near Me on the Day of Judgment.”
